messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're rolling out the new interviewer kits to all active interviewers this Friday via the ATS admin panel. Need to confirm default access levels + scorecard visibility. We'll need a bulk permissions change. Any blockers?

jamal: Contractors question — do external interviewers get edit access to scorecards or view-only?

elaine: Recommend view-only for contractors. Hiring manager can grant edit per candidate if needed. Keeps audit trail cleaner.

samir: I can run the bulk change. Plan: set role=interviewer -> perms=kit:read + scorecard:comment by default. If we need to flip later we can run a second pass. Example staging run command:
```
./ats-admin bulk-perms --input=interviewers.csv --set="kit:view,scorecard:comment"
```

ops_jen: Please enable audit logging for that operation and tag the change with `interviewer-kit-rollout-2026` so compliance can review.

recruitbot: [automated] Bulk operation queued. Job ID: job_84211. Status: pending.

maria: Thanks — ops_jen can you confirm logging? Also we'll host a 30-min Q&A on Fri 11:00am PT for all interviewers to explain kit contents and expectations.

ops_jen: Logging enabled. I set retention to 90 days. Added tag `interviewer-kit-rollout-2026`.

elaine: I'll add Q&A invite and attach the new interviewer checklist + short screencast.

jamal: Doing a small dry run with 5 contractors now.

recruitbot: [automated] Job job_84211 status: running.

samir: Quick heads-up — during staging dry run the scorecard template didn't show for two users. Looks like a role-template mapping mismatch (role name was `interviewer` vs `interviewer_v2` in template service). Re-mapping now.

samir: Patch applied. Re-running bulk on staging.

recruitbot: [automated] Job job_84211 status: success. 5/5 users updated.

jamal: Confirmed — contractors see kit and can comment but not edit. Good to go.

maria: Great. Proceed with production run after business hours Friday. Samir/ops_jen, flag if you want a different window.

samir: After-hours run okay. I'll schedule job for 22:30 PT Friday. Will post prod job ID and link to logs.

ops_jen: Scheduling looks good. I'll watch and escalate if any failures. Also updating onboarding doc: `people-ops/interviewer-onboarding.md`.

maria: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
